title: QuantumIDEReleaseManifest
description: Defines the release manifest metadata for a specific Quantum IDE distribution channel and platform.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the manifest schema format (e.g., 1.0.0)

updateClass.description: Classification governing how Quantum client consumes the update: silent-next-launch applies on next launch; manual-consent requires explicit user approval.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of release publication

available.description: Indicates whether a verified installer asset is actively available for download

downloadUrl.description: Direct HTTPS URL to download the binary installer asset on GitHub Releases

fileName.description: Canonical filename of the installer asset (e.g., Quantum-Setup-0.1.0-beta.1-x64.exe)

sizeBytes.description: Exact size of the installer asset in bytes

sha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest of the installer file

releaseNotesUrl.description: URL to public release notes or changelog
